beat: # The narration script, split into caption-sized lines. This file is the
# source: docs/demo-script.md lists what is ON SCREEN per beat, the words live
# only here, and out/timing.txt reports the measured length of each beat.
# One line here = one caption on screen = one TTS clip. Because each line is
# rendered as its own audio file, the subtitle timings are exact by
# construction: no forced alignment, no guessing.
#   beat    - beat number, matching the shot list in video/demo-script.md
#   gap     - seconds of SILENCE before this line. Use it to let a moment
#             breathe. A line with an empty caption is a pure pause.
#   caption - what the viewer READS. Max ~10 words. Numbers as digits.
#   speak   - what the voice SAYS. Leave empty to speak the caption verbatim.
#             Only fill it in when digits or identifiers would be mangled.
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Keep the header row as-is.

speak: Hindsight. The on-call agent for your data platform.
